GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.label: neutral doctrine influence
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.description: Neutral relations do not alter the permanent doctrine profile of a Goa'uld domain.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.label: rivalry doctrine influence
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.description: Rivalry slightly favors abduction as a source of captives, hosts and prestige without overriding the domain's permanent doctrine.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.label: open-conflict doctrine influence
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.description: Open conflict slightly favors destructive strikes while remaining subordinate to the domain's permanent doctrine and existing eligibility thresholds.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.label: truce doctrine influence
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.description: A truce does not alter the permanent doctrine profile of a Goa'uld domain.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.label: alliance doctrine influence
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldRelationDoctrine.description: Alliance slightly favors direct assaults that can support coordinated forces without changing raid frequency, threat budget or the domain's permanent doctrine.
